title: VP of Technical Operations & Support
text:
**Who We Are**

Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.

Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.

At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!

**Summary/Objective**

The Vice President of Technical Operations & Support is a senior technology leader accountable for the secure, reliable, and seamless support of API's mission-critical software applications and employee systems. This leader sets the strategy for, and runs, all technical operations (application support, incident management, observability, and company and employee systems support) and technical support functions (Customer Support and Tier 2/Tier 3 support teams). With teams based in Canada and India and contract resources worldwide, the Vice President will lead a multi-tier support and operations organization, fostering a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and technical growth. The core objective is optimal system performance and superior customer and employee satisfaction and retention, driven by data and continuous improvement.

**Essential Functions:** *Reasonable* ***accommodations*** *may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Tier 1, Tier 2/Tier 3, customer support, and incident management teams across Canada and India, along with contract resources worldwide, building a high-performing culture across time zones
* Define team structure, roles, and career paths; set goals, KPIs, and performance expectations; and partner with HR and talent acquisition to recruit, coach, and retain skilled professionals
* Partner with infrastructure and application engineering, product, security, and business leaders to ensure product stability and that employee systems meet and exceed business and client needs

**Customer Support & Incident Management**

* Define and implement world-class customer support and incident management strategies, including SLAs, that drive high customer satisfaction and retention for mission-critical applications
* Oversee Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 workflows with clear escalation paths and knowledge transfer to engineering; maintain a searchable knowledge base and self-service resources to reduce repeat tickets
* Own the incident management process end-to-end, including severity definitions, major incident command (with the Senior Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Technical Operations as infrastructure technical lead), and communication to customers and executives
* Monitor ticket aging, MTTR, and CSAT; use the data to identify systemic issues and prioritize improvements
* Serve as the executive escalation point for strategic customers and key accounts, joining business reviews and leading communication during major outages
* Manage 24/7 on-call coverage across time zones, serving as the final executive escalation point for major incidents, with day-to-day on-call handled through team rotations

**Application Reliability & Service Levels**

* Define and enforce SLOs and KPIs for APIs and applications, in partnership with the Senior Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Technical Operations, who owns infrastructure and platform availability; report performance to executives
* Lead blameless post-mortems and drive root cause analysis (RCA), ensuring corrective and preventive actions are completed with engineering
* Partner with engineering and product on change management and release readiness so supportability is built into the software development lifecycle
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery testing for supported applications and corporate systems, in partnership with the Senior Director, who owns cloud infrastructure recovery

**Observability & Monitoring**

* Own observability as a core function of the organization, including monitoring, alerting, logging, tracing, and dashboards for production applications, APIs, and employee systems
* Define observability standards for application teams, including instrumentation requirements, key service indicators, alert severity definitions, and runbook expectations
* Own the observability tooling and platforms (such as Datadog, CloudWatch, Grafana, or equivalent), including configuration, integrations, licensing, and vendors
* Build SLI and SLO dashboards with error-budget tracking so reliability against targets is visible to engineering, support, and executives
* Establish alerting hygiene (actionable alerts, noise reduction, paging policies) and automatic ticket and incident creation in Jira Service Management
* Deploy proactive detection, including synthetic monitoring, anomaly detection, and AI-based correlation, to find issues before customers report them
* Partner with the Senior Director on infrastructure and network telemetry, and with application engineering on instrumentation; report coverage, MTTD, MTTR, and alert quality to executives

**Company & Employee Systems Support**

* Provide executive oversight of helpdesk and end-user support, employee hardware lifecycle, and corporate systems administration
* Oversee the availability, governance, and performance of Microsoft 365, Entra, Teams, and related platforms; partner with security on identity, access, and endpoint standards
* Champion AI-enabled automation across support and operations, such as ticket triage, knowledge retrieval, and self-healing, in partnership with security and AI tooling owners

**Service Management Processes & Partner Alignment**

* Align ITIL-based incident, problem, change, and knowledge management processes with engineering, product, and security partners, with shared severity definitions, escalation paths, ownership, and handoff standards
* Drive continuous improvement through rigorous RCA, with partner teams committing to and tracking corrective actions in a shared backlog
* Build shared dashboards and metrics with partner teams, and extend these processes to external vendors and partners through agreed escalation paths and SLAs

**Strategy, Governance & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Develop and execute a multi-year technology operations and support strategy and roadmap aligned with business goals, product strategy, and growth
* Report regularly to the SVP of Infrastructure Engineering and Technical Operations and executive leadership on service performance, satisfaction, reliability, cost, and initiative progress
* Manage the operations and support budget, including headcount, tooling, and vendor spend, with accurate forecasting and variance analysis
* Lead vendor relationships for support, service management, observability, and employee enablement tools, including negotiations and SLA management

Competencies

* Exceptional leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with experience building, scaling, and retaining high-performing technical teams across geographies and time zones
* Strong service-delivery orientation and commitment to customer experience
* Executive presence; able to convey complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders and translate operational metrics and investment needs into clear narratives for C-suite audiences
* Customer-facing credibility; builds trust with strategic customers and communicates clearly and calmly during outages and escalations
* Strategic thinking balanced with operational discipline, with strong project management skills
* Data-driven; uses SLOs, KPIs, and service metrics to identify trends, prioritize investments, and report on effectiveness
* Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, system design, and software development lifecycle principles, sufficient to partner credibly with engineering during major incidents
* Commitment to a blameless culture and continuous learning; experience with AI-based automation for support efficiency and self-healing

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time, exempt position that can be hybrid or remote. Hybrid employees will be based in either our Melville, NY or Markham, Ontario, Canada office, with a combination of in-office and remote work. Standard hours are Monday through Friday during core business hours. Given the global nature of this role and the 24/7 support model, flexibility is expected to collaborate with teams in Canada and India, and contract resources worldwide, across significant time zone differences, including early-morning or late-day calls to overlap with the India team. Occasional availability outside standard hours may be required for major incidents, outages, and maintenance windows.

Travel

This position may require occasional domestic and international travel (approximately 10%) for team visits, vendor meetings, industry conferences, and cross-functional leadership engagements.

Required Education and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred
* 15+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, systems administration, and/or technical support, including at least 7 years in a senior leadership or executive role (director level or above)
* Proven track record managing globally distributed technical teams, including onshore and offshore employees and contract resources, in a SaaS or enterprise software environment
* Demonstrated experience owning customer support and incident management for mission-critical applications, including SLA/SLO management, post-mortems, RCA, and executive service reporting
* Deep experience with employee enablement tools, including Microsoft 365, Entra, and Teams
* Extensive experience with cloud computing and infrastructure management
* Experience owning observability and monitoring platforms (such as Datadog, CloudWatch, Grafana, or equivalent) and building a metrics-driven approach to operational health
* Working knowledge of ITSM platforms (such as Jira Service Management) and frameworks such as ITIL, and of data analytics tools for performance monitoring
* Experience managing operations budgets for staffing, tooling, and vendors

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience leading technical operations and support at a SaaS or cloud-native company serving enterprise customers
* Experience overseeing technical support or IT staff in India, and managing contract and vendor-supplied resources
* ITIL certification (ITIL 4 Foundation or higher) and hands-on experience administering Jira Service Management
* Experience with AI-based automation for ticket triage, incident response, and self-healing, and familiarity with AI risk and responsible-use frameworks
* Experience in travel technology, hospitality, or other high-volume, customer-facing SaaS environments

Compensation:

The good faith compensation is $200,000 - $220,000 USD.

Compensation is determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set, geographic location, as well as internal alignment and external benchmarks.

**Other Duties**

Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time according to business needs.

The performance of additional responsibilities if you are designated as a Data Protection Champion (DPC), Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO) or Information Assurance Accounting Officer (IAAO).

**Work Environment**

This position operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
